description:
Customize the 'Customer' profile type in Drupal Commerce to enforce B2B data requirements. 

1. Navigate to Configuration > People > Profile types.
2. Edit the 'Customer' profile type and change its Label to 'Business Customer'.
3. Configure the 'Address' field on this profile to make the 'Organization' field REQUIRED (use the Field overrides setting).
4. Add a new field to this profile:
   - Type: Text (plain)
   - Label: 'Contact Phone'
   - Machine name: 'field_contact_phone'
   - Required: Checked (Yes)

The Drupal admin credentials are admin / Admin1234! and the site is at http://localhost.
